newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle sales moderate/$65 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle sales moderate/$65 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle near midday Thursday were trading at $65.00 per cwt in moderate volume, steady with Tuesday's active sales, according to USDA and feedlot sources.

About 12,300 head of slaughter steers and heifers that will likely grade choice and select sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area, USDA reported. About 3,900 head sold in Kansas, USDA said.
Sales were tied to 'clean-up' activity following Tuesday's heavy volume, cattle feeders said. Concern over advancing cold weather also generated sales, they said.
